item.title: Neocon PANIC Over Blue Tsunami, with Jesse Kelly, Plus Shock Twist in Markle Investigation, and Blago on Prison and Freedom | Ep. 1435 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Jesse Kelly, host of The Jesse Kelly Show, to discuss the GOP establishment’s new spin that the Iran war wasn't the cause of the massive midterm losses but it was the ceasefire, the truth about the issues that mattered to Americans, neocons panicking that their power is coming to an end after the disastrous 2026 election, the truth about how their push for the Iran war has led to harming Americans, what Republicans should expect over the next two years from Democratic investigations, why the fallout from 2026 will be felt for years and possibly decades to come, and more. Then Megyn dives into new reporting that Meghan Markle’s half-brother Thomas Markle Jr. is also being investigated as part of the investigation involving her father, Thomas Markle Sr., the shocking details about what police are learning, the latest developments in the investigation into the Florida private plane crash, why "severe turbulence" is such a key component of the investigation, and more. Then Rod Blagojevich, author of "Framed, F*cked, and Freed," joins to discuss what Democrats will do in 2027 and why we should expect them to overreach, what happens to the GOP, what prison was really like for him, the moment he was able to return home to his family, and more.
